sn27.1:1.1: pe || etad avoca || || Yo bhikkhave cakkhusmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || Yo sotasmiṃ chandarāgo || || Yo ghānasmiṃ chandarāgo || Yo jivhāya chandarāgo || Yo kāyasmiṃ chandarāgo || Yo manasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti || nekkhammaninnam cassa cittaṃ hoti || nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittam kammaniyam khāyati abhiññā sacchikaraṇiyesu dhammesūti || ||
